sources.title: NIST Privacy Framework: A Tool for Improving Privacy through Enterprise Risk Management, Version 1.0
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.note: Voluntary privacy-risk management framework (NIST CSWP 10). Not statute; not GDPR/HIPAA determination; not an Enigma certification, compliance determination, DSAR workflow, DPIA app, privacy score, or PII scanner. NIST PF 1.1 draft is not used. Enigma-derived controls are NIST Privacy Framework-informed interpretations for AI action governance evidence.
